commenti.body:
Well, as long as you enjoyed it, that is really all that matters.

I personally dislike the "we are intentionally making a bad movie" genre.

I like my bad movies made with the best of intentions but a serious lack of talent. Lol

You haven't gone into why it's an obviously bad film that's only good for lampooning MS3K style. If it's hilarious and exciting to watch why does enjoying it require rationalization?


I recommend you watch Snakes on a Plane next.

I liked it because it showed the importance of stuff that filmgoers take for granted, like decent lighting, matching shots and following the 180 degree rule. And, yeah, it’s also plenty entertaining. I *did* think the mid-movie switch from a Fin-Nova romantic subplot to a Matt-Nova romantic subplot was kinda creepy.
If you have never seen Slither, also recommend. Not intentionally bad, but intentionally campy and a little silly, but super entertaining and quite well made.
